meta.prompt_suffix: Apart from the Korean words and figures quoted above, every other sign, sheet, screen and label in the frame carries no readable lettering — smaller entries are printed too small and slightly out of focus to read. Do not render English words, Latin letters, Chinese characters, gibberish text, random lettering or invented words anywhere in the image. Style: candid documentary photograph of a real place, not an advertisement, not CGI, not a composite. Shot on a full-frame camera with a 35mm lens at about f/2.8, standing eye level, available light only, true-to-life restrained color, mild sensor noise, a slight handheld tilt, honest texture on skin, wood, glass and metal. Signs may clip a little but the overall image stays natural — never glowing, never hyper-saturated, no HDR look, no rim-light effects, no lens flare; screens, price displays and signboards are lit only by their own real backlight. No title overlay text, no captions, no subtitle bars, no large lettering across the frame, no watermark, no graphic arrows, no highlight circles, no inset panels.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 한 줄: 사람 자리는 불이 꺼졌는데 기계 자리만 켜져서 지금도 일하고 있다. 파트 2·3(근로소득 +0.3% vs 영업잉여 +9.3%)의 시각화 — 유리 한 장으로 「일해서 버는 쪽」과 「기계가 버는 쪽」을 갈랐다. 물리화 채널 4겹: 형태(꺼짐/켜짐·로봇 팔의 들어올리는 방향) + 명암 덩어리(어두운 좌/밝은 우) + 수치(342만 원 / 2,780만 원) + 물리적 흔적(엎어놓은 안전모, 접은 작업대). [A 얼굴] 없음 — 좌우 대비는 대비 자체가 정보(§2-A-0) [B 금액] "342만 2,000원" · "2,780만 원" [C 사건] 로봇 팔이 상자를 들어 올리는 중 [D 주어] 내 급여 안내가 붙은 쪽이 꺼져 있다 [구도] 좌우대비 [텍스트] 제목「먼저 갈리는 내 통장」 vs 썸네일「통장이 갈립니다」
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the photograph fills the entire 16:9 frame edge to edge with a real scene — never a letterbox band, never an empty panel, never a flat colour block, and never a large expanse of bare empty floor. The bottom three-eighths of the frame height is filled by the shadowed concrete floor of the unlit picking aisle and the dark bulk of stacked pallets nearest the camera, so far out of focus and so deeply in shadow that it reads as one single dark mass with no readable detail, which keeps overlay text legible on top of it. No face, no hand, no screen and no bright object sits in that bottom three-eighths — every sign, board and key object sits in the upper five-eighths. Work benches and the notice board run across the MIDDLE of the frame, never near the bottom edge. SCALE, EQUALLY IMPORTANT: the full-height glass partition runs vertically down the exact middle of the frame and splits the picture into two worlds; the printed notice on the left and the metal placard on the right are each about a quarter of the frame width, shot front on, and are the two largest readable things in the image. Photographed at night from inside the human picking zone of a Korean distribution centre, camera at standing eye level. On this side of the glass the lights are switched off: packing benches folded flat, an upturned safety helmet left on a bench, empty steel carts pushed against the wall, and a steel notice board at mid frame height carrying one printed A4 payroll notice whose large top line reads "342만 원" in Korean Hangul and whose smaller second line reads "342만 2,000원", the remaining rows printed too small and slightly out of focus to read. Beyond the glass the automated line is fully lit and running: a yellow industrial robot arm caught mid-lift with a cardboard box halfway off the conveyor, the belt still moving, and a metal placard bolted to the cell frame reading "2,780만 원" in Korean Hangul. There is no person anywhere in the frame; the only motion is on the machine side.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 한 줄: 이자는 분명히 받는데 그 옆 숫자가 더 크다. 파트 5(세후 2.45~2.50% − 물가 2.8% = 실질 −0.3%p)를 은행 창구 안내판 한 장으로 착지시켰다. 확정 리액션 「어? 왜지」를 그대로 얼굴에 얹는다. [A 얼굴] 나 같은 사람(50대 초반 월급쟁이 — 특수직업·다른세대·성공자 아님) [B 금액] "245,000원" (1,000만 원 · 1년 · 세후 연 2.45%) [C 사건] 전광 금리판 숫자가 지금 갱신되는 중 [D 주어] 내가 맡긴 1,000만 원의 1년 치 이자 [구도] 현장군중 [텍스트] 제목「월급만 제자리입니다」 vs 썸네일「이자도 받았고 월급도 나왔는데?」
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the photograph fills the entire 16:9 frame edge to edge with a real scene — never a letterbox band, never an empty panel, never a flat colour block, and never a large expanse of bare empty floor. The bottom three-eighths of the frame height is filled by the dark backs and shoulders of the waiting customers nearest the camera, so far out of focus and so deeply in shadow that it reads as one single dark mass with no readable detail, which keeps overlay text legible on top of it. No face, no hand, no screen and no bright object sits in that bottom three-eighths — every face, hand, sign and key object sits in the upper five-eighths. The teller counter runs across the MIDDLE of the frame, never near the bottom edge. SCALE, EQUALLY IMPORTANT: the man is the largest thing in the picture — his head and shoulders occupy the entire right third of the frame, his face alone spans roughly the top 55 to 60 percent of the frame height, the top of his hair touches the upper edge and is very slightly cropped by it, and his shoulder leaves the frame on the right. The waiting customers behind him are far smaller, roughly one third of his head height. Photographed inside a Korean bank branch on a weekday afternoon, camera at standing eye level on the customer floor, daylight coming through the street-side window. Filling the upper left of the frame, front on, hangs a large wall-mounted deposit-rate board about one third of the frame width: its big line reads "245,000원" in Korean Hangul, a smaller line beneath it reads "1,000만 원 · 1년 · 세후 연 2.45%", and one more small line reads "소비자물가 2.8%"; one digit segment on the board is caught mid-flip as the rate updates. On the right, a South Korean man in his early fifties in a zip-up company jacket holds a printed maturity notice slip at chest height and looks up at the board — inner eyebrows lifted, eyes wide, lips parted, his free hand half raised as if to point and stopped in mid-air.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 한 줄: 내 돈의 네 칸 중 세 칸이 팔기 전에는 못 쓰는 자리에 묶여 있다. 파트 5의 가구 자산 실물 쏠림 75.8%(실물 4억 2,988만 원 / 금융 1억 3,690만 원)를 은행 상담 출력물 한 장으로 세웠다. 얼굴을 넣지 않은 이유: 이 장의 주인공은 종이 위 두 숫자이고 얼굴이 들어가면 그 대비를 가린다(§2-A-0). [A 얼굴] 없음(손만) [B 금액] "4억 2,988만 원" · "1억 3,690만 원" [C 사건] 볼펜으로 아랫줄에 밑줄을 긋는 중 [D 주어] 내 집과 내 통장의 비율 [구도] 화면클로즈업 [텍스트] 제목「먼저 갈리는 내 통장」 vs 썸네일「통장이 갈립니다」
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the photograph fills the entire 16:9 frame edge to edge with a real scene — never a letterbox band, never an empty panel, never a flat colour block, and never a large expanse of bare empty floor. The bottom three-eighths of the frame height is filled by the near edge of the dark walnut table and the deep shadow it throws toward the camera, so far out of focus and so deeply in shadow that it reads as one single dark mass with no readable detail, which keeps overlay text legible on top of it. No face, no hand and no bright object sits in that bottom three-eighths — every sheet, hand and key object sits in the upper five-eighths. The table surface runs across the MIDDLE of the frame, never near the bottom edge. SCALE, EQUALLY IMPORTANT: the printed consultation sheet is the largest thing in the picture and is shot almost front on, filling close to half the frame width, so its two big lines are the first thing the eye lands on; the passbook and calculator beside it are less than half its size. Photographed at a home kitchen table in late afternoon window light, camera at standing eye level looking down across the table at a shallow angle. On the table an apartment title-deed folder lies open, and resting on top of it is a bank consultation printout whose header reads "가계 자산" in Korean Hangul, with a large line reading "4억 2,988만 원" and a small label under it reading "부동산", then a second large line reading "1억 3,690만 원" with a small label reading "예금·주식"; every other row on the sheet is printed too small and slightly out of focus to read. A weathered right hand is drawing a ballpoint line under the second figure at this very moment, the pen still touching paper. Beside the sheet a bank passbook lies open with its rows too small to read, and the fingers of the other hand rest on a pocket calculator mid-press. No face is visible anywhere in the frame.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 한 줄: 사람이 앉던 창구는 꺼졌고, 기계 창구만 켜져서 내 돈을 세고 있다. 확정 제목의 「먼저 갈리는 내 통장」을 2040년이 아니라 오늘 밤 장면으로 이행한다. 글자를 다 지워도 이긴 쪽(불 켜진 기계 쪽)이 읽힌다. [A 얼굴] 없음 — 공간이 주인공 [B 금액] "51,225,000원" (5,000만 원 + 1년 세후 이자 1,225,000원) [C 사건] ATM이 지폐를 세는 중, 화면이 갱신되는 중 [D 주어] 저 잔액이 내 예금이다 [구도] 좌우대비 [텍스트] 제목「2040년 로봇 100억 대보다 먼저」 vs 썸네일「통장이 갈립니다」
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the photograph fills the entire 16:9 frame edge to edge with a real scene — never a letterbox band, never an empty panel, never a flat colour block, and never a large expanse of bare empty floor. The bottom three-eighths of the frame height is filled by the shadowed tiled floor of the vestibule and the dark base panels of the machines nearest the camera, so far out of focus and so deeply in shadow that it reads as one single dark mass with no readable detail, which keeps overlay text legible on top of it. No face, no hand, no screen and no bright object sits in that bottom three-eighths — every screen, sign and key object sits in the upper five-eighths. The ATM keypads and shelf run across the MIDDLE of the frame, never near the bottom edge. SCALE, EQUALLY IMPORTANT: the glass door frame runs vertically down the middle of the picture and splits it into two worlds; the lit ATM screen on the right is shot front on and is about one third of the frame width, the single brightest rectangle in the image. Photographed past midnight from inside the small 24-hour ATM vestibule of a Korean neighbourhood bank branch, camera at standing eye level. Through the glass door on the left, the daytime teller hall is dark and shut down — chairs upturned on the counter, the number-ticket machine dead, a roller shutter half lowered, a single emergency lamp giving the only weak light. On the right two cash machines are fully lit and working with nobody in front of them: the nearer screen shows a bright white banking interface whose large line reads "51,225,000원" in Korean Hangul with a small label above it reading "잔액", the note counter behind the slot caught mid-count with banknote edges blurred by movement, and a laminated notice taped to the glass beside it reads "세후 연 2.45%" with its remaining lines too small and slightly out of focus to read. There is no person anywhere in the frame.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 한 줄: 봉투를 뜯어 보니 숫자가 작년과 거의 같다. 확정 제목의 인용구 「월급만 제자리입니다」를 그대로 얼굴에서 읽히게 만든 컷. 근로소득 342만 2,000원 +0.3%(물가 2.8%의 10분의 1). [A 얼굴] 나 같은 사람(50대 중반 현역 근로자 — 은퇴 이후 톤 아님) [B 금액] "342만 원" · "342만 2,000원" [C 사건] 방금 뜯은 봉투에서 명세서를 끌어올리는 중 [D 주어] 내 이번 달 월급 [구도] 인물클로즈업 [텍스트] 제목「월급만 제자리입니다」 vs 썸네일「이자도 받았고 월급도 나왔는데?」
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the photograph fills the entire 16:9 frame edge to edge with a real scene — never a letterbox band, never an empty panel, never a flat colour block, and never a large expanse of bare empty floor. The bottom three-eighths of the frame height is filled by the man's dark shoulder and chest and by the shadowed locker doors closest to the camera, so far out of focus and so deeply in shadow that it reads as one single dark mass with no readable detail, which keeps overlay text legible on top of it. No second face, no bright object and no readable sign sits in that bottom three-eighths — the face and the payslip both sit in the upper five-eighths. The changing-room bench runs across the MIDDLE of the frame, never near the bottom edge. SCALE, EQUALLY IMPORTANT: the man is the largest thing in the picture — his head and shoulders occupy the entire right third of the frame, his face alone spans roughly the top 55 to 60 percent of the frame height, the top of his hair touches the upper edge and is very slightly cropped by it, and his shoulder leaves the frame on the right. The payslip he holds up beside his jaw is about a quarter of the frame width, shot front on and fully legible. Photographed in a factory changing room at the end of a shift, camera at standing eye level, cool ceiling fluorescents mixing with grey daylight from a high window. A South Korean man in his mid fifties in a navy work uniform has just torn open a pay envelope and is pulling the payslip out and up beside his face right now, the torn envelope still gripped in his other hand. The payslip's large top line reads "342만 원" in Korean Hangul, a smaller line below reads "342만 2,000원", one more small line reads "+0.3%", and every other row on it is printed too small and slightly out of focus to read. His expression: inner eyebrows pulled up and together, eyes wide and fixed on the paper, lips pressed thin then just barely parted, jaw set, a faint sheen of sweat on his temple.

gates.A: 나 같은 사람 (50대 중반 현역 근로자)

thumbnails.concept_ko: 한 줄: 사람 줄은 한 칸만 열려 있고 기계 여섯 대는 혼자 결제를 받고 있다. 확정 제목의 「로봇 100억 대」를 2040년이 아니라 오늘 저녁 동네 마트에서 이행한다 — 물가 2.8%가 실제로 내 지갑을 지나가는 자리다. [A 얼굴] 없음(전경은 등과 어깨) — 대비 자체가 정보 [B 금액] "38,700원" [C 사건] 직원 손이 새 가격 스티커를 지금 덧붙이는 중, 셀프 계산대 결제 진행 중 [D 주어] 저 결제 금액이 내 장바구니 값 [구도] 현장군중 [텍스트] 제목「먼저 갈리는 내 통장」 vs 썸네일「통장이 갈립니다」
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the photograph fills the entire 16:9 frame edge to edge with a real scene — never a letterbox band, never an empty panel, never a flat colour block, and never a large expanse of bare empty floor. The bottom three-eighths of the frame height is filled by the dark backs and shoulders of the shoppers queueing nearest the camera and by their loaded carts, so far out of focus and so deeply in shadow that it reads as one single dark mass with no readable detail, which keeps overlay text legible on top of it. No face, no hand, no screen and no bright object sits in that bottom three-eighths — every screen, sign and key object sits in the upper five-eighths. The checkout counters run across the MIDDLE of the frame, never near the bottom edge. SCALE, EQUALLY IMPORTANT: the nearest self-checkout screen is shot front on at about one quarter of the frame width and is the brightest rectangle in the picture; the queueing shoppers are seen only as dark shapes roughly half its height. Photographed in a Korean hypermarket checkout zone on a weekday evening, camera at standing eye level in the main aisle, ceiling lights dimmed over the staffed side. On the right, a single staffed checkout is still open and a line of shoppers stands behind their carts with their backs to the camera, faces not visible, the aisle above them dim. On the left, a bank of six self-checkout machines runs with nobody standing at any of them, every screen lit bright white; the nearest screen's large line reads "38,700원" in Korean Hangul with a smaller line under it reading "결제 중", and its remaining rows are too small and slightly out of focus to read. At mid frame height a store worker's hand is pressing a fresh price sticker onto a shelf-edge rail at this very moment, the old tag still half visible underneath, the small tags along the rail too small to read.

On the left the living-room television plays a recorded talk: Elon Musk seen chest up with his arms folded, unsmiling, looking straight into the lens. Beside it an opened passbook and a folded supermarket receipt lie on the table, their printed rows too small to read.
